params.body:
Closes the finding `drie-catch-blokken-bedoelden-iets-en-doen-niets`, and there were four.

The finding left one question open: two of the blocks return `400` and it asked what the JavaScript on the other side expects. Answer, from looking rather than guessing: **there is no JavaScript**. `ownvehicle.create.duplicate` is a GET link the dealer clicks and `ownvehicle.index.extendedSearch` is an ordinary form with a submit button; both return a `redirect()` on success. Nobody reads a status code there, so `return 400` was doubly wrong: it never ran (the block catches nothing), and it would have sent the *text* "400" with status 200. Both now report the exception and send the dealer back to his own list with a message.

`UserController::update` keeps the JSON with status 500 the author wrote. What also had to go is the `echo` under it: it printed the exception message on an otherwise empty page with status 200, so the administrator saw the inside of the platform and the browser read it as success.

**The fourth.** `EveryCatchCanCatchTest`, added here, found one nobody had listed: `fetchRequiredFieldsByChassisNumber` caught `\Exception | TypeErrorException`, and that second name resolved through an IDE import to `Psy\Exception\TypeErrorException` — a tinker class that does not exist outside a tinker session. What was meant is PHP's `\TypeError`, which `\Exception` does not cover and which the same method names correctly a few lines further down. Now `\Throwable`, with the error printed instead of an empty block, and the "updated" line moved inside the `try` because it was printed even when the lookup had just failed.

**PHPStan knew.** All three of the original defects sat in `phpstan-baseline.neon` as ignored `class.notFound` patterns. Those three blocks are gone, so the baseline shrinks from 928 to 925.

The lasting part is the test: PHP does not complain about a catch naming a class that does not exist in that namespace, so this checks every file under `app/` and says which class it resolved to.

`R P2-2.11` extended. Full suite green, PHPStan clean.
params.title: Every catch can catch
